themes.title: Worry about running out of time to find a job
themes.interpretation: The student seems to be counting down the time they have left, which may be keeping them awake.

evidence.quote: I lie awake doing the math on how many months I have left.

themes.title: Employers unwilling to sponsor
themes.interpretation: The student describes employers ruling them out, and may be giving up on applications as a result.

evidence.quote: Every company says they can't sponsor, so I just stop applying.
half the employers on it do not hire international students at all

themes.title: No contacts in the industry
themes.interpretation: The student has academic connections but may not know anyone who can help with hiring.

evidence.quote: I don't know anyone in this industry.

recommendations.topic: Look at where the student's network could grow
recommendations.open_question: Who have you met so far who works in this industry?
recommendations.suggested_approach: Brainstorm alumni and professor connections together and plan one first outreach message.

recommendations.topic: Talk through the worry about time
recommendations.open_question: What does the time pressure feel like day to day?
recommendations.suggested_approach: Let them describe the worry before turning to a search plan, and check how much sleep they are getting.
based_on_titles: Worry about running out of time to find a job
